result.reason: The clause reaches a mutual 12-month-fees cap, but it does not satisfy even the fallback overall. The indemnification carve-out applies only to Licensor, not each party, and the retained one-sided liability waivers and Licensee risk-assumption provisions substantially undermine mutuality by broadly insulating Licensor from liability. The stated infringement immunity and liability stack were not deleted despite the margin comment. It also misses the preferred USD 1 million floor, data-protection and IP-infringement carve-outs, and payment-obligations clarification. The edits are targeted and do not alter unrelated commercial terms, but the operative language is internally inconsistent and the bare statement that the consequential-damages exclusion is mutual is poorly integrated with the detailed unilateral exclusion.
